    # Sort busy times by start time
    sorted_busy = sorted(busy_times, key=lambda x: x[0])

    # After all busy times, check if there's free time until end_day
    if prev_end < end_day:

def interval_intersection(a, b):
    i = 0
    j = 0
    result = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        a_start, a_end = a[i]
        b_start, b_end = b[j]
        # Find the overlap
        start = max(a_start, b_start)
        end = min(a_end, b_end)
        if start < end:
            result.append( (start, end) )
        # Move the pointer which has the smaller end time
        if a_end < b_end:
            i += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    return result
